notes.title: TALES FROM CENTROPOLIS is live on Kickstarter
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are excited to announce our '[b]Tales from Centropolis[/b]' Kickstarter campaign is now LIVE!

Our team has been working tirelessly to bring this project to life, and we need your support on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pixelategames/tales-from-centropolis]Kickstarter[/url] to help make it happen. We have a number of exciting rewards available for our backers, including early access to the game, exclusive in-game content, and even the opportunity to have a character named after you in the game.

Join us on this exciting journey and help us bring '[b]Tales from Centropolis[/b]' to life as a video game. Thank you for your support!

[h3]Now's your chance to make an impact.[/h3]
